messages.subject: CFA (COV) in mirt
parts:
Dear Phil.

I am trying to do CFA.
I set COV command but the result doesn't seem to have factor correlation.
Does my script have problems?

Please give me advice, thanks.
--  

model_3c_cor<-mirt.model()
f1=1-5
f2=6-9
f3=10-15
COV=F1*F2*F3
result_3c_cor<-mirt(data,model_3c_cor,itemtype="graded",method="EM",technical
= list(NCYCLES = 100000),SE=T);result_3c_cor
coef(result_3c_cor,SE=T)
summary(result_3c_cor)

messages.subject: Re: CFA (COV) in mirt
parts:
You've defined the factors f1, f2, f3, but gave COV the factors F1 F2
F3. Capital casing matters, so be sure they match.

Phil
